description:
## 1.2.3

Yanosik patches and some universal stuff

patches.name: Less tracking
patches.description: Cuts down on analytics, ad reports, location targeting, Wi-Fi/app scans and crash uploads. Also blocks RevenueCat, so purchases and subscription syncing stop working. Maps and login still go online and may send your location or identifiers.

patches.name: Local PRO
patches.description: Unlocks the app's local PRO settings and hides the Switch to PRO toggle. Doesn't create a purchase or unlock server-only perks.

patches.name: No banner ads
patches.description: Removes banners from the map, navigation and home screen, including the empty ad space. Road alerts and route controls stay.

patches.name: No startup ads
patches.description: Skips ads when Yanosik opens, including cached ones. Normal startup messages and account checks still work.

patches.name: No voice ads
patches.description: Mutes sponsored audio and spoken ads. Directions and road warnings still play.

patches.name: Vibe settings & less PRO spam
patches.description: Adds a saved dark mode toggle for home, sidebar, login, search and maps (on by default). The home PRO shortcut opens Vibe settings instead. Hides upgrade cards, closes the PRO page and removes donation prompts from settings. Direct donation and voucher pages still work.

**🎯 Yanosik target version:**

### **26.9.0**
| 💊 Patch | 📜 Description | ⚙️ Options |
|----------|----------------|-----------|

| [Hide banner ads](#hide-banner-ads) | Clear banner ads and their empty spaces from the map, navigation and home screen. Road alerts and route controls stay in place. |  |
| [Mute voice ads](#mute-voice-ads) | Keep your drive free of sponsored audio and spoken ad campaigns. Navigation directions and road warnings still play normally. |  |
| [Reduce tracking](#reduce-tracking) | Stop the tracking and ad-reporting services covered by this patch, including usage analytics, location targeting, Wi-Fi/app scans and crash uploads. Also blocks RevenueCat, so purchases and subscription syncing won't work. Navigation and sign-in stay online and may still send identifiers or location. |  |
| [Skip startup ads](#skip-startup-ads) | Open Yanosik without startup ads, including campaigns already saved on your phone. Regular startup messages and account checks still work. |  |
| [Vibe settings and fewer PRO prompts](#vibe-settings-and-fewer-pro-prompts) | Open Vibe settings from the home screen and choose a saved dark theme with a Material 3 toggle. Dark mode starts on. Hides PRO upgrade cards and purchase pages, plus donation prompts in settings. Direct donation and voucher pages still open. |  |
